title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Improper Input… (CVE-2026-86365)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 have an improper input validation vulnerability. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially cause a denial of service condition. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality but can affect integrity and availability.
